sections.name: File setup, provenance
sections.title: Test imports and provenance
sections.what: Brings in the test tools, the editor, the helper functions, the 3D library, and the upload check. Also defines a shared provenance record that says the values are schematic assumptions.
sections.why: Likely reason: the provenance record shows the fixture values are assumptions, not source facts.

sections.name: component
sections.title: Component fixture builder
sections.what: Builds a fake model component with a position, size, schedule dates and default settings.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives each test a predictable component to work with.
sections.watch_out: Changes to the component shape must be reflected here, or tests will fail for the wrong reason.

sections.name: model
sections.title: Model fixture builder
sections.what: Builds a fake project model with two components, a facility summary and accuracy figures.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives the tests a realistic project to edit.
sections.watch_out: The fixture is a copy that each test may change, so tests that edit it must reset it.

sections.name: source WBS navigation and specification helpers (part 1)
sections.title: WBS matching and tree checks
sections.what: Checks that path matching respects whole segments, that duplicate branches are kept and counted once, and that editing does not change the original data. It also checks tree depth and shallow leaf display.
sections.why: Likely reason: prevents near-matches such as 20 matching 2 and protects the source data.
sections.watch_out: Matching depends on how segments are split, so changes to the splitting rule change the results.

sections.name: source WBS navigation and specification helpers (part 2)
sections.title: Spacing, specification and move checks
sections.what: Checks that spacing keeps the vertical position and the original data, that resizing scales sibling phases in proportion, that rotation applies as a difference, and that template-only changes stay on one phase.
sections.why: Likely reason: these are the most error-prone editing rules, so they need explicit checks.
sections.watch_out: Expected numbers are fixed in the tests, so intentional rule changes need updated expectations.

sections.name: source WBS navigation and specification helpers (part 3)
sections.title: Asset batch and render checks
sections.what: Checks that cylinder resizing and batch size limits are enforced, and that the editor renders its controls without fetching anything automatically.
sections.why: Likely reason: stops the editor from making hidden network requests and makes limit errors clear.
sections.watch_out: The render test stubs the browser window, so it may not catch layout problems.

sections.name: source WBS navigation and specification helpers: for
sections.title: Refinement and equipment shape checks
sections.what: Checks the refinement file count and size limits, then checks that each new equipment shape builds several parts, sits at the expected position, and receives its rotation.
sections.why: Likely reason: prevents fallback boxes from appearing in place of real equipment shapes.
sections.watch_out: The loop disposes each part's geometry and materials, so reusing them later in the same test would fail.

summary: Tests the schedule-based model editor: WBS path matching and tree building, spacing and resizing of asset phases, validation limits, the editor's rendering, refinement upload limits, and the 3D shapes for new equipment.
purpose: Protects the editor's rules so that changes to the model do not silently break its editing behaviour.
why: Likely reason: the editor changes real model data, so checks prevent accidental damage.
how: Builds small fixture models and components. It then checks path matching, tree building, spacing and resizing outcomes and error messages, upload limits, the rendered text, and that new 3D shapes contain several parts.
inputs: Fixture models, components and edit requests created inside the test file.
outputs: Pass or fail for each test.
risks: Fixtures are simplified, so some real cases may not be covered. The rendering test checks text only, not the layout.
debug: If a test fails, read the expected and actual values printed. Check the matching helper in parametric.ts or the upload check it names.
